title: 第26章 怪物第27章 归家
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
他并没有选择向前迎敌，而是做出了一个出人意料的决定——向后。
这个动作流畅得仿佛他已经练习过无数次，就像是一个精心编排的舞蹈动作，他精准地退到了远处，同时顺手一把拉住还有些发愣的克莱恩，将他一同带到了相对安全的后方。
在完成这一切后，奥莱尔才微微气喘，他拍了拍克莱恩的肩膀，脸上带着一种介于严肃和教导之间的神情，压低声音快速道，“记住，克莱恩，手无缚鸡之力的我们，要学会给别人腾场地，不能妨碍他人的发挥，尤其是他们这些专业人士。”
克莱恩一时语塞，看着前方邓恩和伦纳德的背影，又瞥了一眼身旁这位经验丰富的前辈，心中五味杂陈。
他开始反思，原来，他们都是这样参与战斗的吗？
克莱恩早就知道了，无论是莫甘娜的学徒、老尼尔的窥秘人、自己的占卜家乃至极光会的秘祈人，都是没有什么战斗力的。
所以，在出任务的时候，他们需要保护好自己，将战场留给能战斗的人？
克莱恩学到了，可是有些许不服，自己也不是没有战斗力。
他拿出手枪，瞄准，看着即将出现的敌人，准备给他一枪。
而那边被奥莱尔理所当然归为专业人士的艾尔·哈森，甚至连头都没回。
他只是用眼角的余光极其冷淡地扫了奥莱尔一眼，那眼神复杂难明，混杂着无奈、鄙夷和一种“果然如此”的麻木。
他似乎对这一切早已习以为常，对奥莱尔的提醒和克莱恩的紧张都显得漠不关心。
他什么话都没说，仿佛任何言语在这种情境下都是浪费。
因为，战斗已在瞬息间爆发！
“每当太阳在西方下沉”
“露珠缀满黄昏的衣襟”
“她素颜苍白的如同月明”
“或如伴随月亮的星星”
……
在艾尔·哈森那悠扬的吟唱声中，一位身着黑色燕尾服、头戴半高丝绸礼帽的小丑缓缓走出。

他的正式装扮与脸上画出的小丑模样形成鲜明对比，让人感到一种难以言喻的诡异氛围。
黑色的燕尾服在灯光下闪烁着微光，而那顶半高礼帽则显得有些过时，却也增添了几分神秘感。
小丑的脸上涂着夸张的白色油彩，红唇和黑色眼线勾勒出一个永恒的微笑。
邓恩的反应速度极快，小丑刚一出现，他就毫不犹豫地扣动扳机，目标直指小丑的面门。
然而，令人震惊的是，子弹竟然直接穿透了小丑的身体，仿佛他只是一个虚无的幻影。
小丑的身体开始一片片蒸发，最终消失得无影无踪。
“那是幻觉，序列7魔术师。”奥莱尔一边继续担任辅助工作，一边冷静地解释道。
他还没有找到合适的时机出手。
克莱恩看得目瞪口呆，短短几秒钟内，那位小丑已经制造了不下五次的幻觉。
克莱恩还注意到，小丑的响指似乎也是某种攻击手段。
克莱恩一边思考，一边继续开枪攻击小丑。
尴尬的是，尽管他开了好几枪，却没有一枪命中目标。
小丑已经迅速移动到了仓库的屋顶，似乎打算进入其中。
content_en:
He did not choose to move forward to meet the enemy, but made an unexpected decision - to move backward.
This movement was as smooth as if he had practiced it countless times, like a well-choreographed dance move. He accurately retreated to a distance, and at the same time grabbed Klein, who was still in a daze, and brought him to a relatively safe place in the rear.
After finishing all this, Orel was slightly out of breath. He patted Klein on the shoulder. With an expression between seriousness and instruction on his face, he lowered his voice and said quickly, "Remember, Klein, we who are powerless must learn to make room for others and not hinder the performance of others, especially professionals like them."
Klein was speechless for a moment, looking at the backs of Dunn and Leonard in front of him, and then at the experienced senior next to him, with mixed feelings in his heart.
He began to reflect, did they all participate in the battle like this?
Klein has known for a long time that whether they are Morgana's apprentices, Old Neil's secret peepers, his own diviners or even the secret prayer men of the Aurora Society, they all have little fighting power.
So, when going on a mission, they need to protect themselves and leave the battlefield to those who can fight?
Klein learned it, but he was a little dissatisfied. He was not without fighting ability.
He took out his pistol, took aim, looked at the enemy who was about to appear, and prepared to shoot him.
And Al Hasson, who was naturally classified as a professional by Oler, didn't even look back.
He just glanced at Orel with an extremely cold look from the corner of his eye. The look in his eyes was complicated and difficult to understand, mixed with helplessness, contempt and a kind of numbness that "sure enough".
He seemed to be accustomed to all this, and seemed indifferent to Olaer's reminder and Klein's nervousness.
He said nothing, as if any words would be wasted in this situation.
Because the battle has broken out in an instant!
"Whenever the sun sets in the west"
"Dewdrops fill the skirts of dusk"
"She is as pale as the moonlight without makeup"
"Or like the stars accompanying the moon"
…
Amidst Al Hassan's melodious singing, a clown wearing a black tuxedo and a half-high silk top hat slowly walked out.
His formal attire contrasts sharply with the clown look painted on his face, giving people an indescribably weird atmosphere.
The black tuxedo shimmered under the light, and the half-top hat seemed a bit outdated, but it also added a bit of mystery.
The clown's face is painted with exaggerated white paint, red lips and black eyeliner outline an eternal smile.
Dunn's reaction speed was extremely fast. As soon as the clown appeared, he did not hesitate to pull the trigger, aiming directly at the clown's face.
However, what is shocking is that the bullet penetrated the Joker's body directly, as if he was just a phantom.
The clown's body began to evaporate piece by piece, and eventually disappeared without a trace.
"That's an illusion, Sequence 7 magician." Orel explained calmly while continuing to work as an assistant.
He hasn't found the right moment to take action yet.
Klein was stunned. In just a few seconds, the clown had created hallucinations no less than five times.
Klein also noticed that the clown's finger snapping seemed to be some kind of attack method.
While thinking, Klein continued to shoot at the clown.
Embarrassingly, although he fired several shots, none of them hit the target.
The clown has quickly moved to the roof of the warehouse and seems to be planning to enter it.
